description_sq:
Shesim apartament 2+1 se bashku me nje post parkimi ne Kompleksin +Forest Residence, tek Rrethrrotullimi i Shkozes.
+Forest Residence perbehet nga 255 apartamente me shumellojshmeri tipologjish. Ne kat ndodhen vetem 3-4 apartamente per te ofruar intimitet dhe komoditet banoreve. 
Perbehet nga godina 8 kateshe te tarracuara dhe 2 kate parkim nentoke.
Te dhenat dhe organizimi i apartamentit:
- 1 Sallon me ambient gatimi
- 2 Dhoma gjumi
- 1 Tualet
- 1 Korridor
- 1 Ballkon me dalje nga dhoma dhe salloni
- Siperfaqe neto 96.3m2
- Siperfaqe totale 109.7m2
Per me shume informacion, me kontaktoni!
title_en: +FOREST RESIDENCE, APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1 +1 PARKING SPACE
description_en: We are selling a 2+1 apartment together with a parking post in +Forest Residence Complex, at Shkoza Roundabout. +Forest Residence consists of 255 apartments with a variety of typologies. There are only 3-4 apartments on the floor to offer privacy and comfort to the residents. It consists of an 8-story terraced building and 2 underground parking floors. Details and organization of the apartment: - 1 Living room with kitchen - 2 Bedrooms - 1 Toilet - 1 Corridor - 1 Balcony with exit from the room and living room - Net area 96.3m2 - Total area 109.7m2 For more information, contact me!
